Kids Bible Class · August — Week 5

God Loves Me

John 3:16; 1 John 4:9-10

“How you made me is amazing and wonderful.”

Psalm 139:14 (NIrV)

God loves you so much that He gave His Son, Jesus.

Image 1

God loves the whole big world —

and that means God loves YOU.

Image 2

God's love is bigger than the tallest sky.

It is deeper than the deepest sea.

Image 3

God showed His great love in the best way of all.

He sent His own Son, Jesus, to us.

Image 4

We didn't have to earn God's love.

God loved us first — just because He wanted to.

Image 5

Nothing can ever stop God from loving you.

Not ever.

God made you, God knows you, and God loves you — forever.

What We Learn

God loves you more than you can imagine — bigger than the sky and deeper than the sea. He showed His love by sending His Son, Jesus. We didn't have to earn it; God loved us first, just because. And nothing can ever stop God from loving you.

For you: Whenever you feel sad, small, or unsure, remember the biggest truth of all: God loves you, He always has, and nothing will ever change that.
